requests.summary: PKT-014 currently emits API-resource href values where the packet describes existing owner-screen navigation through plan_ref and recommended_actions.

details.reason_not_safe_to_guess: The PKT-014 screen contract requires payload-owned refs. The frontend must not rewrite API-resource hrefs into guessed browser destinations.

requests.requested_follow_up: Publish browser-ready owner-screen refs for PKT-014, or revise the PKT-014 contract, screen spec, and example payload so they explicitly describe API-resource links rather than owner-screen navigation.
